title: A Echo for the Machine
author: Dominic Galloway
blurb: Kestrel Galloway, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
